note: Small bar-and-campground on 100-acre Poquette Lake west of Spooner, with a sand beach, docks and a bar open Friday and Saturday nights. The shaded Area 1 sites face east toward the lake through a band of trees. Mostly seasonal: many of its 40 sites are rented by the season, with some kept for weekenders and vacationers. --Claude
summary: Operator pages, Google and imagery read. $50 + tax W&E confirmed (week: 7th night free), water, 40 sites, showers/flush/dump, May 1-Oct 1, phone booking. Lakeview kept (Area 1 faces the lake through a tree band). Passes price at exactly $50; Google 4.7 (59); mostly seasonal with nightly share unmeasurable. Unsourced 30A, sewer and 34-ft max flagged.
